title: Bayesian Nonparametric Thompson Sampling for Multi-Armed Bandits
abstract: arXiv:1808.02932v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In stochastic multi-armed bandits, rewards are generated by an unknown distribution; the world's reward uncertainty induces the exploration-exploitation trade-off. Thompson sampling (TS) addresses this trade-off elegantly, but requires knowing the reward model's parametric form to sample from its posterior and compute per-arm expected rewards ---which limits its applicability as it demands per-scenario model specification and hyperparameter tuning.   We here adopt Bayesian nonparametric (BNP) mixture models to remove this requirement, extending TS to arbitrary reward distributions. We model each arm's unknown reward distribution with an independent BNP Gaussian mixture, which can approximate any continuous reward density, and adapts its complexity to sequentially observed data. translated_title: 面向多臂老虎机问题的贝叶斯非参数汤普森采样
translated_abstract: 在随机多臂老虎机问题中，奖励由未知分布生成；世界的奖励不确定性引发了探索与利用之间的权衡。汤普森采样优雅地解决了这一权衡问题，但它需要预先知道奖励模型的参数形式，才能从其后验分布中采样并计算每个臂的期望奖励——这限制了它的适用性，因为它要求针对每个具体场景进行模型设定和超参数调整。本文采用贝叶斯非参数混合模型来消除这一要求，将汤普森采样扩展到任意奖励分布。我们用一个独立的贝叶斯非参数高斯混合模型来刻画每个臂的未知奖励分布，该模型可以近似任意连续的奖励密度，并能根据顺序观测到的数据自适应地调整模型复杂度。将贝叶斯非参数混合模型嵌入汤普森采样，得到了非参数汤普森采样算法，该算法能够按顺序学习最接近真实（但未知的）奖励分布的模型。
tldr: 本文提出用贝叶斯非参数高斯混合模型对每个臂的奖励分布建模，将汤普森采样扩展到任意奖励分布，从而无需针对具体场景预先设定参数化奖励模型和调整超参数。
en_tdlr: This paper embeds Bayesian nonparametric Gaussian mixture models into Thompson sampling, extending it to arbitrary reward distributions and removing the need for per-scenario parametric model specification and hyperparameter tuning.
